brandWorld.brandPersonality: Bold, warm, phone-native — a bank that feels like a friend, not a institution
brandWorld.visualDirection: A mobile-first fintech workspace built around Up's coral-as-canvas identity: cards are dark (near-black) sitting on a warm coral ground, with electric yellow used as the punch accent for headings and CTAs. The feel is kinetic but structured — like a well-designed banking app blown up to presentation scale.
avoid: Dark navy or black backgrounds — Up's world is warm coral, not cold dark
Generic AI orbs, particles, or gradient blobs
Glassmorphism panels — Up uses solid dark cards, not frosted ones
Formal serif typography — Up is a geometric grotesk brand through and through
Muted pastel fintech palette (sage, sky blue, off-white) — this brand shouts
Thin hairline aesthetic — Up is bold weight, generous radius, friendly not austere
brandWorld.whyThisWorks: Up's brand lives in the tension between warmth (coral, rounded cards, playful yellow) and sharpness (mono labels, precise data, no fluff) — a mobile bank for people who check their balance like they check their feed. The deck mirrors the app: coral canvas, dark card surfaces, yellow as the data highlight.
motifs: Rounded dark transaction cards with balance amounts in yellow mono
Coral surface as the primary workspace ground — not a background wash
Pill-shaped category tags (Eating Out, Transport, Bills) in yellow on black
Spending sparklines rendered in yellow on dark card surfaces
Pink (#ff8bd1) used as a decorative ink accent on secondary elements
brandWorld.backgroundSystem: Flat coral surface (#ff705c) — no gradient blobs, no noise — with dark cards floating on top at 24px radius
brandWorld.deckTheme: Coral-ground mobile bank deck: dark rounded cards, yellow data labels, pink accents — the Up app at presentation scale
